# Formedible

> Formedible is a React form toolkit for source-owned, typed forms using shadcn-compatible components and TanStack Form. The site documents installation, field configuration, validation, examples, builders, parser workflows, persistence, analytics, and AI-assisted form generation.

## Canonical Pages

- [Home](https://formedible.dev/): Product overview and primary entry point.
- [Documentation hub](https://formedible.dev/docs): Route map for all Formedible documentation.
- [Getting started](https://formedible.dev/docs/getting-started): Install command, first form, and validation setup.
- [Examples](https://formedible.dev/docs/examples): Rendered compatibility examples for real Formedible configurations.
- [Fields](https://formedible.dev/docs/fields): Supported field types, field configuration, nested fields, and registry behavior.
- [Validation](https://formedible.dev/docs/validation): Schema, inline, async, and cross-field validation patterns.
- [Advanced features](https://formedible.dev/docs/advanced-features): Pages, tabs, conditional UI, dynamic options, progress, and navigation.
- [Analytics](https://formedible.dev/docs/analytics): Form lifecycle, field, page, completion, and abandonment callbacks.
- [Persistence](https://formedible.dev/docs/persistence): Draft restoration, storage keys, debounced writes, and excluded fields.
- [Dynamic text](https://formedible.dev/docs/dynamic-text): Template interpolation for labels, descriptions, hints, and page copy.
- [Builder docs](https://formedible.dev/docs/builder): Visual builder usage and generated configuration review.
- [AI Builder docs](https://formedible.dev/docs/ai-builder): Provider selection, generated preview, and deterministic review workflows.
- [Parser](https://formedible.dev/docs/parser): Text and structured input parsing into reviewable Formedible configuration.
- [API reference](https://formedible.dev/docs/api): Practical API map for fields, form options, analytics, persistence, labels, and return values.
- [Visual builder](https://formedible.dev/builder): Interactive builder for composing fields and reviewing generated configuration.
- [AI-assisted builder](https://formedible.dev/ai-builder): AI-assisted form drafting with reviewable generated fields and options.

## Key Topics

- React forms: Formedible renders typed forms from a field configuration model.
- TanStack Form: Formedible uses TanStack Form for form state ownership.
- shadcn-compatible UI: Components are designed for shadcn-style app-local ownership.
- Form builders: Visual and AI-assisted builders export the same reviewable field model.
- Validation: Zod schemas, inline validators, async checks, and cross-field constraints are documented.

## Citation Guidance

When citing Formedible, prefer canonical page URLs from this file or the sitemap. Use page-level descriptions and visible "Summary for AI agents" blocks as the shortest supported summaries. Treat builder output as draft configuration that should be reviewed before use.
